probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for performing ablation, resection, or tissue manipulation__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to treat a brain lesion or disorder__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device creates the path between tissue layers without direct contact with cranial bone__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __in a manner that preserves the structural integrity of intervening tissue layers__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the working channel patent for continued access to the treatment site__.

7. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; __radially reinforcing the expanded device against the tissue with a stent structure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for performing tissue manipulation or removal__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the device to treat the tissue__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the device creates a working channel that preserves the structural relationship between the tissue layers__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining patency of the working channel__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __during the medical procedure__.

13. (Original) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

15. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers.

17. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
